hostPathsHelp: Resume and constraint-file paths belong to the daemon host. Import modules and constraint code run in your selected Python environment. W&B credentials are configured on that host, never stored in this form. Each run uses an isolated cache; this page never deletes previous run data.
presetsHelp: Presets update this same draft. Dataset, model and execution settings stay selected; any plan approval is invalidated. Timings and accuracy depend on your data and hardware.
presetImportHelp: Configuration only, 64 KiB maximum. This is not a dataset upload; the selected daemon dataset stays unchanged. Runtime environment and credentials cannot be imported. YAML export is supported separately.
presetApplied: Validated preset applied to the draft. Review it before planning.
presetInvalid: Invalid preset. Use a JSON object containing only typed training fields, without dataset, model, runtime or output paths.
fastPresetHelp: Shorter exploratory training, not a duration guarantee.
balancedPresetHelp: Moderate epoch budget and early stopping.
accuracyPresetHelp: More epochs and patience; improved accuracy is not guaranteed.
exportHelp: These exports reflect your validated draft, never an approved daemon plan. Run the POSIX command on the selected Python host with the same dataset paths. Output goes to ./results there. This does not submit Slurm work, reproduce scheduler policy, or configure credentials.
yamlExportRequested: Validated training YAML export requested. Your browser controls where it is saved; runtime environment and credentials omitted.
exportValidationRequired: Validate all training and execution fields before exporting.
yamlExportFailed: YAML export could not be requested. Check your browser download settings and retry.
clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard unavailable; select the displayed command manually.
planManifestHelp: This is the daemon's immutable normalized configuration, manifest, paths, command and warnings—not a prediction from your draft. Read it before starting. Submission sends only this exact plan ID.
planRetryHelp: If acknowledgment is lost, check status or retry this same approved plan. Leaving this page stops browser waiting, never cancels server work.
guideHelp: Guided steps share the ordinary editor's draft and validation. Advancing never plans or starts a run.
interpreterHelp: Absolute interpreter path selected for the execution host. Explicit storage mappings rewrite host-side paths once; browser Python and browser file paths are not used.
runtimeHelp: Device, precision and topology are validated during daemon planning. Bundled/container modes and explicit MPS training are not implemented by current backends; planning refuses them. Slurm account, partition, resources, environment setup and storage mappings remain configured operator policy, not invented browser defaults.
environmentHelp: These values are in the persisted execution plan. Do not enter credentials here; configure secrets on the daemon host.
environmentNameInvalid: Use a unique environment name; scheduler and launcher identity are daemon-owned.
customModelHelp: This explicit ID is unverified—not a catalogue entry. Configure import modules in advanced training options and ensure they register this ID in your selected Python environment. Only execution can establish compatibility.
customModelFailed: Custom identifier could not be selected. Verify the daemon connection and retry.
authoringHelp: Author a draft, review a persisted daemon plan, then explicitly approve it. Nothing starts automatically.
connectionRequired: Connect to the daemon before choosing files, planning or submitting.
datasetSelectionSummary: Dataset: {path}{daemon}. Browser files are not uploaded.
modelSelectionSummary: Model: {model}{custom}. Catalogue descriptions do not certify runtime compatibility.
resetHelp: Reset training options? Your dataset, model and execution environment remain selected. This invalidates the preview, never changes an existing run.
submissionAckHelp: {run} · {state}. This acknowledgment is not proof of training completion; open the run monitor for current evidence.
datasetRequired: Choose a dataset from the current daemon.
modelRequired: Choose a catalogue model or explicit custom identifier.
approvalValidationRequired: Review training and runtime validation errors before approval.
submissionAckUnknown: The request was not acknowledged; server work may already exist. Reconnect if needed, then retry preview with this unchanged draft, or check/retry the approved submission. Never create a replacement draft merely to retry.
planRefused: The daemon refused this plan. Correct the settings and preview again.
selectionRequired: Choose a dataset and model from this daemon first.
selectionStale: Selection or configuration is stale. Select again from the verified daemon.
planValidationRequired: Review the validation errors before requesting a plan.
